phase: Before initial complete-turn recovery application edits
method: Exact AST-extracted initial query options, loading/error/empty JSX, ReaderState and apply-once effect with installed QueryObserver and real reader-window complete-turn helpers. Other Reader UI is excluded. Transport, hook scheduling, owner/auth, navigation state and DOM focus are doubles.
controls: Successful initial data is applied once as complete turns
Genuine empty success remains distinct from failure
Offline errors retain the original raw error branch with no new remote retry
A missing remembered anchor uses the existing first-turn fallback
The original query key and position/detail enablement decision are unchanged
failure_groups: No localized Retry messages control exists in the initial error, so the new retry/ownership/focus contracts cannot yet run
Raw transport errors appear instead of plain localized recovery/access copy
The original query error remains after an independent target window has been accepted

harness_correction_before_baseline.cause: The first extractor counted the containing JSX content prop as a fourth state because it searched descendants rather than each conditional's own condition.
harness_correction_before_baseline.correction: Require a ConditionalExpression and inspect its condition; exactly the three real loading/error/empty state expressions are selected.
